title: Premiere: Geistform - PI 10.4  [Pi Electronics]
description:
Artist: Geistform
Title: 'PI 10.4'
Label: Pi Electronics
Cat. #: π10
Format: Vinyl & Digital
Release: 30th October,​ ​2020
Pre order: https://pielectronics.bandcamp.com/album/pi10-10

Sounds From NoWhere is pleased to premiere a new Geistform' gem on 'Pi Electronics'.
Geistform, also known as Raffael Espinosa, is the producer behind Pi Electronics record number 10. 
After almost three decades of music making, he delivers a 5 track-EP fusing influences from techno, electro and '90s IDM. 
PI10.5 is a slower burner with emphasis in the chaos brought by its distorted baseline themes - to be found only on the Pi Electronics Bandcamp page.
